evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: Rep says 'do you have about fifteen minutes to run through that with me?' but never frames the time-box + dependable quote promise or waits for a yes — jumps immediately into 'do you have just any type of mind, questions or concerns'
evidence_quotes.their_agenda: Before I kinda hop in too deep do you have just any type of mind, questions or concerns that I can kick us off with here — asked before probing logistics
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Customer raises concern about flexible date ('lease ends on the fifteenth'), rep responds 'we do have a flexibility so as long as we have availability... no additional fees' then asks 'did you have any other things?' — stops after one layer, no 'tell me more about that'
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: Rep gives $204/hr rate, $75 trip fee, mentions 2.5–3.5 hours range and calculates $585–$738, but does not anchor to 'typical for a home this size' or explicitly personalize to this customer's specific factors (tight bedroom access, flexible date, minimal items)
evidence_quotes.pricing_framing: Trip fee mentioned ($75), 2.5-hour minimum stated, but no explicit 'not a guess' framing, no 15-minute-increments commitment, and no upfront disclosure of other potential fees beyond what was mentioned
evidence_quotes.feels_fair_then_silence: Never asked — rep moves directly to 'we do have that truck available, no deposit to book... did you want to go ahead and reserve that truck?'
evidence_quotes.on_time_guarantee_delivered: Rep says 'we have our on time guarantee attached to that as well... if we arrive even just a moment out of the time window... then money is automatically deduct off the final deal' — mentions guarantee and automatic deduction but does not clearly state discount starts immediately or specify the discount amount/terms
evidence_quotes.damage_coverage_delivered: Rep says 'the note where we damage coverage that does cover-up to $22,000 for any kind of incidentals' — mentions $2,000 coverage (transcribed as $22,000 but context suggests $2,000) but does not frame 'no deductible / no fine print' or confirm it's built into the rate, not an add-on
evidence_quotes.closes_the_loop: No question asked like 'Does that put those to rest?' — rep moves from promises directly into truck availability and booking
evidence_quotes.final_concerns_check: Rep asks 'do you have any other just additional questions or anything like that I can help you with?' — throwaway 'any questions' rather than genuine 'what's still concerning you about this move?'
evidence_quotes.catch_all_asked: Never asked — no version of 'Anything coming with you we haven't talked about?'
evidence_quotes.explicit_ask: Rep says 'did you want to go ahead and reserve that truck?' — asked plainly without a built-in out

top_strength: Chauntelle gathered comprehensive logistics details (property types, floor access, stairs configuration, truck parking, no additional stops, time preference) and discovered the customer's core need (help with large items only) quickly and efficiently.
coaching_note: Chauntelle did not deliver the Two Promises section at all — no clear On-Time Guarantee terms, no damage coverage no-deductible framing, and no 'Does that put those to rest?' — and she skipped the critical 'Does that feel fair?' + silence pause before asking for the business, which left pricing unconfirmed and customer comfort unvalidated.
